scope: Independent single-batch saved-pixel-only review of eight whole desktop/mobile surfaces.

observations: The heading and printed-page line sit above a centered, consistent prose column. Paragraphs and horizontal section rules remain distinct, with no visible lines colliding or extending beyond the column.
Figure 201's sloping test surface, base plate, right-hand shaded area and three principal labels are fully framed. Its caption has space below the diagram and above the following section.

Figure 202's layer rectangles, vertical ray, left thickness marker and right medium labels fit within the figure area. The top heading and bottom ray note are separated from the surrounding prose and caption.

Displayed fractions and the numbered equation have visible whitespace around their blocks; no definite collision with adjacent paragraphs is apparent. The concluding paragraphs and blue Exercises control have bottom clearance.
staticViewLimits: view_image automatically displayed the 1440x8084 original at 1069x6000. Small subscripts, fraction glyphs and caption details are not certified character by character, nor is a precise minimum text size inferred.

observations: The full exercise heading is contained on one line; the printed-page line and blue Questions accent are separated from it and from the list.
All six numbered prompts are visible. The longer fourth and fifth prompts wrap within the same column; divider lines sit between prompts rather than through their text.
The fifth prompt's stacked 1/n fraction has visible room above and below its baseline, and the parenthetical italic n does not collide with adjoining prose.
The Back to text control is fully visible below the sixth prompt with clear spacing and contained text.
staticViewLimits: Only the saved list and control appearance were inspected; navigation and any unseen exercise state were not tested.

observations: The title, Answers heading and top separator are distinct. Numbered sections 1 through 6 have consistent left alignment and clear gaps before their paragraphs.
Long answer paragraphs wrap inside the centered column. Section separators do not cross text, and the two paragraphs in section 4 remain visually separate.
Inline mathematical runs in sections 4 and 5 are accommodated by their lines without visible collision; the stacked fractions in section 5 have adequate vertical spacing.

Section 6's three-item list and following mathematical paragraph are fully visible. The inequality, numbered fraction equation and scientific-notation run do not visibly run into the right margin or neighboring lines; the last paragraph has bottom whitespace.
staticViewLimits: This is a layout observation, not approval of answer correctness, exact subscript identities or completeness against a source.

observations: All six question groups are visible and separated by horizontal rules. Multi-line stems stay within the prose column.
Circular controls in groups 1, 2, 4 and 5 and square controls in groups 3 and 6 are visually distinct from their letter labels and option text.
Continuation lines align with the option-text column rather than flowing underneath the controls or letters. Long options have whitespace between rows and no visible inter-option overlap.
The fifth stem's wavelength expression and the 1/n runs in its options fit inside their lines. The sixth group's A-F rows, including the final option, are fully framed with bottom clearance.
staticViewLimits: Unselected control appearance is the only state evidenced. Selection, judging, focus, keyboard behavior and choice semantics are outside this review.

observations: The title wraps into two lines above the printed-page line. The narrow prose column keeps side margins throughout the long capture, and paragraph gaps and section rules remain visually distinct.

Figure 201's sloping top, base and right-hand shaded region fit within the available width. The top, interior and bottom label runs are visible without obvious contact with the figure boundary; its caption remains below it.

Figure 202's top heading, left marker, centered ray, rectangles, right-hand labels and bottom note all appear within the column. No definite framing loss or label overlap is visible at this displayed scale.
The separate equation blocks do not visibly spill beyond the column. The final prose block and blue Exercises control are included, with whitespace beneath the control.
staticViewLimits: view_image automatically displayed the 390x12163 original at 192x6000. This severe reduction permits gross wrapping and framing inspection but not reliable fine-glyph, small-label or original-size readability certification. No crop, zoom or reopen was used to overcome that limit.

observations: The exercise title occupies two contained lines without touching the printed-page line. The Questions accent and heading have space above the first divider.
All six prompts are visible with consistent side margins. The third, fourth and fifth prompts wrap across multiple lines without text meeting the divider lines.
The fifth prompt's 1/n fraction and parenthetical italic n are legible at the presented scale and have clear line spacing; its final question line remains inside the right edge.
The Back to text control fits below the sixth prompt; its label is contained and the capture includes whitespace beneath it.
staticViewLimits: The saved pixels show no keyboard, scrolling, navigation result or alternate control state.

observations: The title wraps into two lines above the Answers heading. Sections 1 through 6 have fully visible numbers, paragraphs and intervening separators.
Paragraphs use contained narrow-column wrapping. Section 4's second paragraph and its inline pi and path-length expressions are spaced away from surrounding lines rather than overlapping them.
In section 5, the wavelength equation begins on a new line and the stacked 1/n fractions have visible vertical clearance. No equation extends past the side margin.

Section 6's numbered list wraps within the column. Its following inequality and fraction equation remain contained, and the scientific-notation run occupies a spaced line; the final sentence is visible with bottom whitespace.
staticViewLimits: No exact subscript transcription, science re-review or original-source comparison was performed. The observation concerns the visible spacing and containment of mathematical runs.

observations: The two-line title, Choices heading and first question stem fit within the narrow page. All six question groups are visible with separated divider lines.

Circular and square controls occupy a consistent left column; option letters occupy the next column and continuation lines remain aligned under option text. No visible text crosses a control or letter.

The long fourth-group options wrap into several contained lines, including the hyphenated quarter-wavelength run. The fifth stem's wavelength expression and option 1/n runs remain within the available width with adequate line spacing.
The final group's A-F options are fully visible, and the F option ends above the capture boundary with whitespace below. No definite clipping, row overlap or framing defect is apparent.
staticViewLimits: view_image automatically displayed the 390x6180 original at 379x6000. Fine glyphs are not certified at an exact pixel size, and only the saved unselected control state was inspected.

conclusion: No definite visible clipping, overlap or figure-framing defect was found in the eight supplied saved images. PASS applies only to the observable static pixel scope, with the documented display-scale limits.
staticViewLimits: Only the eight unique manifest originals were opened, once each, with view_image. No other images, reopens, crops, zooms or derived images were used.
A saved capture boundary is an evidence limit, not proof of a broken container. Unseen content, other widths, other states and actual scrolling cannot be inferred from these captures.
No interaction, judging, keyboard, scrolling, ARIA, complete English accessibility, font identity or loading, or headed acceptance is certified by this review.

Tool-side automatic downscaling was observed and explicitly recorded for the desktop text, mobile text and mobile choices images. Original-resolution minimum text size and precise small glyphs are not certified.
Source, science, English, choice semantics, native and DOM approvals are reused as instructed; none was re-reviewed or independently revalidated here.
Manifest bytes and hashes are retained as supplied input bindings, not claimed as newly recomputed image checksums.
closesReadyScope: This saved-pixel-only batch is complete and ready for owner closure using the existing separate approvals. This is not an independent whole-ticket or headed acceptance certification.
